name: Coin
desc: Wages from the mill and the ferry road. Twenty is all a loose purse carries.
flavor: Counted twice on the way home, as everyone in Lowbridge counts it.

name: Herbs
desc: Clean bundles for Granny Shu's stall, and the ten the Foundation sitting burns.

name: Timber
desc: Straight lengths for racks, frames and a roof of your own. Six is a full stack without a shed.

name: Channel stone
desc: Water-set stones that keep the shape the stream gave them.

name: Qi
desc: A reservoir gathered by the slip's breath method. Techniques spend it; the Foundation attempt wants it full and does not take it.

name: Attunement
desc: Methods held ready in the mind. Attuning a technique fills one place, and a technique must be held before it can be used.
flavor: You can remember reading a method and still be unable to use it.

name: Vigor
desc: Strength for the day's chores. It comes back on its own whether you are busy or idle, and quicker still if you lie down to it.

name: Strain
desc: How much broken ground the body will take before it must turn back. Ridge outings draw it down; it returns slowly, busy or idle.

name: Life
desc: What a blow takes before the body gives way. Only a fight draws on it; it returns slowly on its own, busy or idle, and Circulation deepens it.
flavor: Nobody in Lowbridge counts it until somebody swings at them.

name: Strike
desc: What a blow of yours carries. A strike lands for what it has over the other's guard.

name: Guard
desc: What a blow against you is turned by. Their strike lands for what it has over it.

name: Speed
desc: How often you swing. In a fight your readiness fills by your Speed each second, and you swing each time it reaches five: at Speed 1, every five seconds.

name: Hit
desc: Your chance, in percent, to put a swing where you meant it. The other's Dodge takes its share of what remains.

name: Dodge
desc: Your chance, in percent, to be elsewhere when a swing arrives. Nobody slips more than three in five.

name: Marrow herbs
desc: Bitter roots from the disturbed ground around the survey marker. The Body bill wants twelve, more than a new store holds.

name: Whetstone grit
desc: Fine grit cut from the inscription face. The Sword bill wants twelve, more than a new store holds.

name: Veined ore
desc: Ore that keeps the grain of the ground it came from. The Earth bill wants twelve, more than a new store holds.

name: Inked tokens
desc: Counters that hold a layout once it has been tested. The Formation bill wants twelve, more than a new store holds.

name: Home space
desc: Spans of floor already in use. Arrangements come with you when the home grows.

name: Coin earned
desc: Every wage paid since you came to Lowbridge, raises included. Trades and bounties are not wages.

name: Lore
desc: The slip's surviving characters, and how many of them you can read.
flavor: Three leaves of twelve, and the cracks take a little more each year.

events.text: The carver's hand sorts itself out under your brush. Proper tools would let you go where the characters point.

name: Qi Sense
desc: Feeling where qi gathers and where it runs. Each level widens the reservoir and sharpens a held method.

events.text: Something that is not air moves under the breath, and it pulls two ways: toward the broken channel beyond the barns, and upstream to a hollow of ferns.
The faint pull from upstream has a shape now. Fernhollow can be sat in.

name: Circulation
desc: The slip's method, made whole enough to move qi through the body. Each level also deepens Life by two and adds one to Strike and Guard.
needtext: Channel stones set in the floor, or three dusks sat in Fernhollow.

events.text: The turn holds on its own for a breath. The method is whole enough to settle.

name: Herb Lore
desc: Granny Shu's eye for a good bundle and a bad one.

name: Labour
desc: Sacks, timber and freight harden the back and teach it to pace itself.

name: Stone Sense
desc: How a stone sits in moving water, and where it will sit again.

name: Composure
desc: Stillness that outlasts the sitting.

name: Foundation
desc: The reconstructed method holds without you watching it.

name: Faint trace
desc: A thread kept through stillness. It stays distinct from the channel's flow pattern.
